calls.title: Scott Keller Role Play Exercise
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on what was discussed (product, features, pain points), key participants and their roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Scott Keller (sales rep), Brenton Holloway (playing VP Eng at Roblox), Ryan McGurk (observer/manager), Webflow Demo (Graham? observer). The call is a role play exercise to assess Scott's sales skills.

What was discussed: Product is GrowthBook (experimentation/feature flag platform). Pain points: Roblox uses multiple tools (homegrown, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) leading to fragmentation, data silos, slow experiment cycles (only 30% of features tested, week-long waits for data science). Key features: open-source, fixed seat pricing (no success tax), data warehouse integration, ability to consolidate.

Next steps: Scott proposed a 2-week trial (instead of 90 days) with a kickoff call next Friday, involving key stakeholders. Negotiation scenario: Brent wanted price cut to $60k vs list $100k; Scott countered with three-year deal at $85k/year average, with added value (unlimited seats 90 days, waived implementation, etc.). Eventually agreed at $85k/year with 10% employee buffer. Action: Scott to send quote.

But summary must be 2-3 sentences focusing on the three bullet points. Need to condense.
